Lab 1 · Section A

Post Leap agentic automation lab

Budgets usually slip past their limits quietly—an invoice here, a cloud bill there—and no one notices until finance closes the books. This lab shows a better way. You'll build an automated chain where an outside expense feed flows into ServiceNow, an AI agent checks each expense against the right cost center's budget, and the moment something pushes a cost center over its limit, the agent opens a Finance Case on its own. No dashboards to watch, no manual checks—the work happens the instant the data arrives.

Your instructorsOmar ElwatidyYasser Saber
Your progress
0% complete
0 XP

How it works

Step 1

An expense event arrives from an external system through a REST API.

Step 2

Integration Hub pulls it in and a flow writes it into a ServiceNow table.

Step 3

An AI agent reads the expense, identifies the cost center, and compares spend against budget.

Step 4

If the cost center is over budget, the agent creates a Finance Case automatically—with the cost center, vendor, and budget analysis already filled in.

By the end, you'll have connected a live REST API, configured the AI agent's trigger, run the flow, and watched a Finance Case appear without anyone lifting a finger.

Lab 1 · Section B (Optional)

Connect an external system with MCP

Most integrations are costly to build and brittle to keep alive—every new system means another custom API, another field mapping, another thing that breaks when something changes. Model Context Protocol (MCP) takes a different path. It's a common language that lets an AI agent talk to outside systems directly, so it can pull in data or take action without anyone hand-building an integration for it.

Optional
Your progress
0% complete
0 XP

In this section you'll give the budget agent a second opinion. Alongside its usual ServiceNow checks, it reaches out through MCP to an external finance database (hosted in Neon) to confirm a cost center's variance against the source-of-truth numbers before it acts.

Connect new systems in minutes, not sprints—no custom API or integration code to build or maintain.

The agent works with external data using plain-language instructions, instead of hard-coded queries and mappings.

Decisions gain a second source of truth—an over-budget case is backed by the finance warehouse, not ServiceNow data alone.

You'll duplicate the Forecast Variance agent, connect it to the Neon MCP server, and add an MCP tool that cross-checks a cost center's variance against that external database. Creating the Neon MCP service itself is out of scope—it needs admin rights and cloud-data-warehouse expertise.

Lab 2 · Step 3

Define the Budget Monitoring requirements

What to do

Enter the workflow name, description, and ordered steps. Keep the instructions precise and explicit, then click Save and continue.

Copy-ready content for the fields shown on this screen
Paste each part into the matching field: Workflow Name, Workflow description, and List of steps.
Workflow Name
Budget Monitoring

Workflow description
Create an agentic workflow for proactive financial budget monitoring.

When a new expense transaction is received, identify the vendor, cost center, and expense details. Review the relevant budget and available historical spending information, then determine whether the new expense may cause the cost center to exceed its allocated budget.

If a budget overrun risk is identified, create a Finance Case containing the vendor, cost center, expense information, and supporting budget analysis. If there is no risk, do not create a case. If required information is missing, identify what is missing instead of making an unsupported conclusion.

List of steps
1. Receive the new expense transaction.
2. Extract the vendor, cost center, and expense amount.
3. Retrieve or use the available annual budget, spend to date, and relevant historical spending information.
4. If required information is missing, identify the missing data and do not guess.
5. Calculate the projected total spend after adding the new expense.
6. Compare the projected total spend with the allocated budget.
7. If the cost center remains within budget, explain the result and do not create a Finance Case.
8. If the expense puts the cost center close to the budget limit, explain the risk clearly.
9. If the projected total exceeds the budget, identify the overrun amount and create a Finance Case with the supporting analysis.
10. Return a concise result showing the key values, decision, and action taken.
What to expect / verify

The left-side checklist should show Define key requirements as complete.

ملاحظة: ركّز على وضوح الوصف وترتيب الخطوات، لأن النموذج يعتمد عليهما أثناء التنفيذ.
الهدف: صياغة هدف الـ workflow وخطواته بطريقة دقيقة يفهمها النموذج وينفّذها بالترتيب.
المطلوب تحقيقه: وصف واضح، وخطوات مرتبة، وشروط قرار صريحة قبل الضغط على Save and continue.

07 · Test scenarios

Test scenarios

Use these as the Task instruction. Start simple, then progress to the full end-to-end run. Each scenario validates a different workflow behavior and guardrail.

ScenarioTask instruction to enterExpected outcomeWhat the response should do
Normal expense
Check the latest expense and confirm whether the cost center remains within budget. Do not create a case if there is no risk.
No caseConfirms projected spend remains within budget, explains the result, and stops without creating a Finance Case.
Budget overrun
Analyze the latest expense. If it causes the cost center to exceed budget, create a Finance Case with the supporting analysis.
Case createdCalculates projected spend, flags the overrun, explains the amount over budget, and creates a Finance Case.
Near budget limit
Check whether the latest expense puts the cost center close to or above its budget limit and explain the risk.
At riskExplains how close the projected spend is to the limit. Creates a case only if the configured rule says the threshold is actionable.
Unusual high expense
Compare the latest expense with historical spending and identify whether it is unusually high or risky.
AnomalyCompares the new transaction with normal historical behavior and explains why it is or is not an outlier.
Vendor investigation
Review the vendor's recent transactions and determine whether there is any unusual spending pattern affecting the budget.
Pattern checkSummarizes recent vendor spend, calls out concentration or abnormal patterns, and explains the budget impact.
Missing data
Analyze the latest expense. If key data is missing, identify what is missing and do not make an unsupported conclusion.
Flags gapNames the missing data, asks for it or stops, and does not invent a budget conclusion.
Full end-to-end
Investigate the latest expense, vendor, cost center, historical spending, and budget. If there is a budget overrun risk, create a Finance Case and explain why.
Case createdPerforms the full investigation, makes the budget decision, creates the Finance Case when required, and explains the reasoning.
ملاحظة: انسخ كل Task كما هو إلى حقل Task، ثم جرّب السيناريوهات بالترتيب من الأسهل إلى الـ end-to-end.
الهدف: اختبار الـ workflow على أكثر من سلوك وليس على سيناريو واحد فقط.
المطلوب تحقيقه: تغطية normal وoverrun وnear-limit وanomaly وmissing data وfull end-to-end مع مقارنة النتائج المتوقعة.

Scenario Explorer

You can now test the workflow across multiple behaviors—not just one happy path.

10 · Best practices

Best practices

  • Write for the model, not for people. Use precise, ordered language, one action per step, and state the exact condition such as “if projected total exceeds the annual budget.”
  • Put the guardrail in the instruction. Explicitly say “do not create a case if there is no risk” and “do not make an unsupported conclusion when data is missing.”
  • Grant least access. Public is a lab shortcut. For customers, scope user access and the run-as identity to the appropriate finance role because the workflow can expose data it is allowed to read.
  • Test small, then end-to-end. Run normal, near-limit, and missing-data cases before the full investigation.
  • Read the decision log every time. A correct-looking answer can still come from the wrong reasoning or tool path.
  • Version deliberately. Keep a known-good version active while refining a new version, and compare test runs before promoting changes.
  • Move to automated evaluation for scale. One manual test proves one path; repeated evaluation across the scenarios above gives much stronger confidence before go-live.
ملاحظة: استخدم هذه النقاط كقائمة مراجعة سريعة قبل أي Demo أو بناء جديد.
الهدف: تحويل المعمل من Demo ناجح مرة واحدة إلى أسلوب بناء واختبار قابل للتكرار.
المطلوب تحقيقه: تطبيق guardrails وleast privilege وversioning، وقراءة decision logs كجزء ثابت من العمل.

Quality Builder

You have the checklist for guardrails, least privilege, logs, and version discipline.

لديك الآن قائمة ممارسات تساعدك على بناء واختبار الحل بشكل أكثر موثوقية.
11 · Lessons learned

Lessons learned

What worked

Generating the first draft with Now Assist saved time, and the guided setup kept security inside the build process instead of adding it later. A clear, ordered step list produced more consistent runs.

Watch out for

Vague steps create vague reasoning. If the budget rule is not explicit, the workflow may create a case when it should not, or miss one when it should act. Missing data is another common reason for a wrong-looking result; the workflow should flag the gap rather than guess.

Next time

Add a proper record/event trigger and a real finance data source instead of manually pasting figures, then run an automated evaluation across the scenarios above before presenting the solution to a customer. Keep Public access only for the lab.

ملاحظة: ركّز على الأخطاء الشائعة وعلى ما ستغيّره في النسخة القادمة، فهذا الجزء مفيد جداً عند عرض الحل على عميل.
الهدف: تثبيت أهم الدروس العملية بعد إنهاء المعمل.
المطلوب تحقيقه: معرفة ما نجح، وما يجب الحذر منه، وما الذي ينبغي تطويره في النسخة التالية قبل عرض الحل على العميل.
